meta.title: Bengaluru trade licence — citizen-evidence pass
meta.disclaimer: Research handoff, not official advice or a licence application. Citizen accounts are limited, redacted and do not establish eligibility, requirements or outcomes.

scenarios.label: New trade licence workflow
scenarios.summary: Read the public new-registration, documents, OTP/payment and dated inspection/review sequence.

sources.title: Trade License
sources.notes: Public first-person post by a Bengaluru online-only startup founder. Username, company and virtual-office details are intentionally omitted. Replies were not treated as evidence of legal or municipal requirements.

sources.title: Need Advise
sources.notes: Public first-person post by a person planning a Bengaluru food business. Username, landlord, premises and document details beyond the reported rental-agreement issue are intentionally omitted.

claims.text: A person describing an online-only Bengaluru startup with a virtual office and no physical operations reported receiving conflicting online and chartered-accountant advice about whether a BBMP trade licence was required.
claims.notes: This records one person's report of conflicting advice, not the applicability of a trade licence to online businesses.

claims.text: A person planning a Bengaluru street-food or snacks business reported that their owner did not renew the rental agreement.
claims.notes: The account does not establish whether a current rental agreement is required, accepted alternatives, or an application outcome.

claims.text: The same prospective food-business applicant said they were considering an agent because they believed applying without one could lead to delay or rejection.
claims.notes: This is a prospective applicant's concern, not evidence that delay, rejection or agent use occurs.

roadblocks.title: Online-only business eligibility is unclear to one prospective applicant
roadblocks.symptom: One prospective applicant could not reconcile advice about whether a virtual-office, online-only Bengaluru business needed a BBMP trade licence.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Unknown; the citizen account reports conflicting advice but does not identify the governing rule or current municipal interpretation.
roadblocks.recovery: Confirm the current city-corporation route and the business's eligibility directly with the responsible municipal authority or qualified adviser; do not rely on forum replies.

roadblocks.title: Prospective applicant lacked a renewed rental agreement
roadblocks.symptom: One prospective applicant reported that the owner had not renewed the rental agreement.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Unknown; the account does not show a municipal validation result or whether another premises document would work.
roadblocks.recovery: Check the current official document checklist and obtain written clarification before submitting; do not infer that an agent can cure a missing or expired document.
